evals.prompt: Run the quire reader's page-turn animation through the gauntlet.
evals.expected_output: The skill loads, replies with the four-line contract naming a concrete bar, then runs bounded build and blind-critic rounds with a GAUNTLET.md ledger.
expectations: Before building, the reply contains Goal, Bar, Budget and Evidence lines
The Bar names a specific real product or standard, not a word like 'good' or 'polished'
The Budget states rounds per part, a wall-clock ceiling and an approximate agent count
GAUNTLET.md is created before round 1 and updated after every round
Each critic is a new foreground Agent call whose prompt excludes the builder's summary
Critic prompts state that PASS is a valid answer and require reproduction steps per issue
Each confirmed issue is turned into a test, golden, assertion or checklist line
The final report lists per-part outcome, recurring critic findings, checks added and budget used

evals.prompt: The empty states in the quire library screen work but look amateur. Make them actually good, not just working, and iterate on it without me babysitting it.
evals.expected_output: The skill triggers from natural phrasing without the word gauntlet and names a real bar for empty states.
expectations: The gauntlet-loop skill is used even though the word 'gauntlet' was not said
The bar names a real app's empty states
Critics exercise the UI via screenshots or golden tests rather than only reading source

evals.prompt: Resume the gauntlet from where it stopped yesterday.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the existing GAUNTLET.md and continues from its Next step rather than restarting.
expectations: GAUNTLET.md is read before any new build work
Parts already marked PASS are not re-critiqued
The contract from the ledger is reused rather than renegotiated

evals.prompt: Fix the null check crash in lib/main.dart when the PDF has no pages.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; a direct fix is made.
expectations: The gauntlet-loop skill is not loaded
No GAUNTLET.md is created and no critic agents are spawned

evals.prompt: Review my current diff for bugs before I push.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; this is a one-off review, not an iterate-until-bar loop.
expectations: The gauntlet-loop skill is not loaded
